concerns.text: The plan cites OpenML dataset ID 42123 as the primary source of surface‑roughness and tribology data and assumes it contains columns `Sa`, `Sq`, `Ssk`, `Sku`, `Sp`, `Sv`, `coeff_friction`, and `wear_rate`. OpenML ID 42123 is not a surface‑roughness/tribology dataset (it corresponds to a different domain), so it cannot provide the required features. Using this dataset would make the entire analysis incapable of answering the research question.
